fixed_work.controls: check Full Copy parent invariance and path values across root orders; compare WCTR
fixed_work.denominators: no replacement of ineligible states; report comparisons separately; orders are repeated measures; calibration, replay and rescue calls counted separately
fixed_work.expansion: depth-first; first three distinct frozen actions
fixed_work.replay: selected two-action sequence from pristine root with raw-on-per-edge deep copies
fixed_work.rescue: single-edge raw-on-deep-copy in fresh raw order; require both restored sibling input and reference action for causal attribution
fixed_work.resets: pristine root and fresh model/adapter per arm and order; WCTR calibrates 32 transitions
fixed_work.score: count of top-level goal keys present with equal canonical value; max leaf per root
fixed_work.stopping: complete fixed tree without goal stop, deadline or deduplication
fixed_work.ties: lowest frozen child index, then lowest frozen root index; report all ties

serializer.alias_paths: typed key/index tokens; root path []; sort path digests within each shared mutable group, then sort groups; retain closing edge of cycles
serializer.encoding: UTF-8 JSON, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, compact separators, allow_nan=False; SHA-256
serializer.values: historical benchmark.canonical hierarchy; goal is already canonical
